```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: `FeaturePlot`s of the individual genes making up Sophie's subtype
signatures (`PScripts/14.5-endocardial_mesenchymal_egfp_analysis.py`), on
the Endocardium + Mesenchyme, all-samples, cell-cycle-genes-removed object.
14.5 already plots the *combined* signature score per subtype
(`sc.tl.score_genes()`, one value per cell); this instead shows each
contributing gene as its own panel, same style as `15.7`'s c0-c12 plots.

Note: `Esco2` (Proliferating signature) is not present in this object's
feature set, so that panel is 1 gene (Hist1h2ap) only. None of these genes
are flagged as negative markers in the source script - `sc.tl.score_genes()`
treats the whole list as one positive-direction signature - so no +/-
labelling here, unlike the c0-c12 plots.

# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
```

# User defined functions

```{r}
save_if <- function(plot_object, filename, width, height, ...) {
  if (save_plots) {
    ggsave(plot = plot_object,
           filename = filename,
           width = width,
           height = height,
           dpi = 300)
  }
}
save_plots <- TRUE
```

# Set project directories and file paths

```{r}
project_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak/20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"
data_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir", "15-rna_velocity")
new_out_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "subcluster_marker_featureplots")

if (!dir.exists(new_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(new_out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# Load required object
- Endocardium + Mesenchyme, all 4 samples, cell-cycle genes removed, from
  `15.1-add_EGFP_metadata_subset_endocardium_mesenchyme_no_cc.Rmd` - same
  object used in `15.7`.

```{r}
all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc_re_embed.rds"))
stopifnot(inherits(all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc, "Seurat"))

"umap_endo_mesen" %in% Reductions(all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc)
table(all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc$new_celltypes)
```

# Shared plot builder

```{r}
make_signature_featureplot <- function(object, genes, title) {
  FeaturePlot(
    object = object,
    features = genes,
    reduction = "umap_endo_mesen",
    ncol = 2,
    order = TRUE
    ) &
    scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),
      name = "Expression"
    ) &
    plot_annotation(
      title = title,
      caption = "Endocardium + Mesenchyme, all samples, cell-cycle genes removed"
    ) &
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) &
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
}
```

## Endocardial subtype signatures

- Ventricular

```{r}
ventricular_markers <- make_signature_featureplot(
  all_samples_endo_mesen_no_cc,
  c("Irx5", "Tgfbr3", "Emcn", "Frem1"),
  "Ventricular signature markers"
)
save_if(ventricular_markers,
       filename = file.path(new_out_dir, "15-umap.ventricular_markers.png"),
       width = 12,
       height = 10)
```

angiogenic_markers <- make_signature_featureplot(
